$comment: The status and meaning of each code in contracts/schemas/error-codes.json, for the errors reference. scripts/build-reference.mjs fails the build if a code is here and not in the contract, or the other way round.

NOT_AUTHENTICATED: No one is signed in: there was no token. Sign in.
ACCESS_DENIED: Signed in, but without the authority this needs.
NOT_FOUND: No such thing — or one of another organization, which answers the same. Also an unknown path.
CONFLICT: It already exists, or is in a state that forbids the change.
INVALID_REQUEST: The request is malformed or breaks a rule: a missing or invalid field, an unreadable body, a malformed id, an unsupported method.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something failed on the server. The message reveals nothing; the request id finds it in the logs.
AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Sign-in refused: unknown user, deactivated account or wrong password — deliberately indistinguishable.
AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: The refresh token is unknown, expired or signed out: sign in again.
AUTH_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong passwords. Retry-After and details.retryAfterSeconds say when to try again.
SESSION_EXPIRED: A token was sent and refused: expired, its session ended, the person deactivated or the organization suspended. Renew it, or sign in again.
SESSION_REVOKED: Renewal refused: the session was ended (password changed or reset, signed out everywhere, ended from the sessions list, switched away from), or a replaced refresh token was sent again after the 30-second grace, which ends the whole session. Sign in again; tell them why.
ORG_ACCESS_DENIED: Not a member of the organization asked for (signing in to it, or switching to it).
ORG_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Someone in several organizations signed in without choosing one. details.organizations lists them; sign in again with organizationId.
PROFILE_INVALID: A profile field, contact address or preference failed validation.
CONTACT_LIMIT_REACHED: Too many contact addresses on one profile.
CONTACT_DUPLICATE: That address is already on the profile, for that channel and scope.
CONTACT_VERIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: No code can be sent on that channel: nothing is set up to deliver it.
CONTACT_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED: A code was asked for again too soon.
CONTACT_VERIFICATION_NOT_STARTED: Confirmed without a code having been sent, or after it was used.
CONTACT_VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The code has expired: ask for a new one.
CONTACT_VERIFICATION_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes: ask for a new one.
PASSWORD_INVALID: The new password breaks the rule (8 to 128 characters).
PASSWORD_INCORRECT: The current password, given to confirm a change, is wrong.
PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID: The reset link is unknown, used or replaced by a newer one.
INVITATION_INVALID: The invitation is unknown, withdrawn or replaced.
INVITATION_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: An account exists for the invited address: sign in, then accept.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: Signed in as someone other than the person invited.
INVITATION_ALREADY_MEMBER: The person is already a member of the organization.
INVITATION_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: Invitations can't be delivered: no email is set up, or the links' base URL is not set.
INVITATION_RATE_LIMITED: The invitation was re-sent too soon.
EMAIL_IN_USE: Another account signs in with that address.
EMAIL_UNCHANGED: The new address is the current one.
EMAIL_CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE: No code can be sent to the new address: nothing is set up to deliver it.
EMAIL_CHANGE_RATE_LIMITED: A code was asked for again too soon.
EMAIL_CHANGE_NOT_STARTED: Confirmed without a change having been started.
EMAIL_CHANGE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes: start again.
SIGNUP_DISABLED: Signing up is not open here (signup.mode is invitation), or the deprecated register is off (signup.legacy-register).
SIGNUP_EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The email domain is not in signup.allowed-email-domains.
ORGANIZATION_NAME_IN_USE: Another organization already has that name: choose another.
SIGNUP_REQUIRED: A provider sign-in found no account and sign-up is open: details carry email, name and provider; ask for an organization name, then POST /egradx/auth/oidc/signup with the same code.
AUTH_NO_ACCOUNT: A provider sign-in found no account and sign-up is not open: details carry provider, providerName and email. Joining takes an invitation.
EMAIL_CODE_UNAVAILABLE: No code can be emailed: codes are turned off, or nothing delivers account messages (egradx-notification-auth).
EMAIL_CODE_RATE_LIMITED: A sign-up code was asked for again too soon (email-code.resend-interval, 60 s).
EMAIL_CODE_INVALID: Not the code sent, or no code was sent to that address (an unknown address answers the same).
EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired (email-code.ttl, 10 minutes): ask for a new one.
EMAIL_CODE_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes: the code is gone, ask for a new one.
OIDC_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN: No such provider is configured, or it is turned off.
OIDC_CANCELLED: The person declined at the provider. Given to the frontend callback page as ?error=, not as an HTTP answer.
OIDC_STATE_INVALID: The provider came back for a round trip that is unknown, used or expired. Given to the frontend callback page as ?error=.
OIDC_FAILED: The provider could not be reached, or what it answered did not check out. Usually given to the frontend callback page as ?error=.
OIDC_CODE_INVALID: The result code from the callback is unknown, used or expired: start the sign-in again.
OIDC_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: The provider does not vouch for the email, so it cannot make an account or be linked to one.
IDENTITY_LINK_REQUIRED: An account has that email, but this provider is not trusted to prove it: sign in another way, then link the provider from the profile. details: provider, providerName, email.
IDENTITY_IN_USE: Another account already signs in with that provider identity. After linking from the profile, given as ?error=.
SIGN_IN_METHOD_REQUIRED: Removing this provider would leave the person no way to sign in: set a password first.
NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND: No such notification for the caller (marking another person's as read answers the same).
TEMPLATE_INVALID: A template can't be rendered or stored, or a message's model doesn't fit its type: a missing required variable, an undeclared one.
CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE: The channel can't send for this organization: not set up, or turned off.
AUDIENCE_TOO_LARGE: A bulk send to more people than egradx.notification.bulk.max-recipients (1000 by default).
RECIPIENTS_UNREACHABLE: Some users have no verified address on the channel. skipUnreachable() sends to the others instead.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than egradx.files.max-size (25 MB by default), or than profile-photo.max-size (5 MB) for a profile photo. A proxy's own limit in front of the API answers a bare 413 instead.
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: The file's content type is not in egradx.files.allowed-content-types, or is not PNG, JPEG or WebP for a profile photo.
FILE_EMPTY: The upload had no file part, or the file has no bytes.
FILE_REJECTED: A scanner of the application's (EgradxFileScanner) refused the file; its bytes were removed.
FILE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The storage backend can't be reached: the folder can't be written, or the bucket doesn't answer. Try again later.
